context: A barista and her friend bake a chocolate dessert together
purpose: Teach: 牛乳/サラダ/キッチン/チョコ/食っ/栽培/分解/望ん

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: メイ、キッチンに材料そろえたよ。チョコと牛乳、あとバターね。
lines.en: Mei, I've got the ingredients ready in the kitchen — chocolate, milk, and butter.
lines.style: Warm, practical, hostess-mode barista voice setting up the workspace.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: わあ、夢みたい…一緒にチョコケーキ作るのずっと望んでたの。
lines.en: Wow, it's like a dream... I've been wishing forever that we'd bake a chocolate cake together.
lines.style: Dreamy, soft, almost whispered with romantic sparkle in her tone.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うちのカフェのレシピね。牛乳の量で食感が全然変わるの、面白いよ。
lines.en: It's the recipe from my cafe. The amount of milk totally changes the texture — it's fascinating.
lines.style: Confident, teacherly, with quiet pride in her professional craft.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ねえ、このカカオもどこかの農家が大事に栽培してくれたんだよね…なんかロマンチック。
lines.en: Hey, this cacao was lovingly grown by some farmer somewhere, right... that feels kind of romantic.
lines.style: Dreamy, sentimental, gazing at the chocolate with starry-eyed wonder.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: ふふ、メイらしい発想。私は味を分解して考えちゃうかな、苦味と甘味のバランスとか。
lines.en: Haha, what a Mei thought. I tend to break the flavor down — bitterness versus sweetness and so on.
lines.style: Gently amused, analytical, smiling at her friend's romantic tangent.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵ってほんと職人だね…あ、横の作り置きサラダ、ちょっとつまみ食っちゃった、ごめん。
lines.en: Aoi, you're such a craftsman... oh, I nibbled a bit of the leftover salad on the side, sorry.
lines.style: Sheepish, giggly, caught mid-bite with affectionate embarrassment.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: もう、つまみ食いしないで!オーブン温まったから、型に流し込もう。
lines.en: Hey, no nibbling! The oven's heated up, so let's pour it into the mold.
lines.style: Playfully scolding, hands-on-hips bossy in a warm friendly way.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: はーい。焼き上がり、世界一になりますように。
lines.en: Okay, okay. May this turn out to be the best in the world.
lines.style: Singsong, hopeful, closing her eyes like making a little wish.
